reason: Provides tools for compressing, incrementally updating, inspecting, and auditing agent skill documents while preserving extracted rules, workflows, tool requirements, and output constraints.

summaries.zh: 用于压缩、增量更新、检查和审计智能体技能文档，并保留其中的规则、工作流、工具需求与输出约束。
summaries.en: Provides tools to compress, incrementally update, inspect, and audit agent skill documents while retaining their rules, workflows, tool requirements, and output constraints.

capabilities: Reads skill documents supplied to its tools
Extracts and restructures typed skill contracts
Audits rendered skill text against extracted contract data
Uses an optional LLM for structured extraction and relation decisions
